evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 7.9 ppm before growth, following a stable low-oxygen ramp.
Pressure rose to 3.072 Torr and oxygen to 10.1 ppm.
Pressure and oxygen continued rising to 3.135 Torr and 18.2 ppm.
Pressure reached 3.212 Torr and oxygen 24.3 ppm despite argon flow of 99.9 sccm and temperature of 750.0 °C matching setpoints; the correlated upward drift suggests a process anomaly.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust-conductance check would distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction or another gas-system disturbance; no sample characterization is available.
